subject.title: docs(skills): allow model-usage with Linux codexbar

question: Should OpenClaw make Linux hosts with an existing `codexbar` binary a supported bundled `model-usage` path?
rationale: The implementation is additive and directly proven, but it turns a previously macOS-only bundled skill into an explicit Linux support commitment.

options.title: Accept bundled Linux support
options.body: Merge the focused metadata and documentation update, retaining the existing `codexbar` requirement as the eligibility boundary.

options.title: Keep Linux external-only
options.body: Do not merge the bundled-skill expansion and direct Linux users to an external skill or portable exported-JSON workflow instead.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled Linux support
recommendation.body: Merge the focused metadata and documentation update, retaining the existing `codexbar` requirement as the eligibility boundary.
